item.tib: gshin rje'i gtor bskul dzo dmar 'khyil ba
item.coloph: drag po rngams (rngam) pa me dpung tsha tsha las/ drag po khrom bskul srog gi spu gri gsungs/ khro rgyal ya man Ta ka'i gsungs par legs/ grub gnas dam pa rtse drug lhun sgang du/ dus mtha'i rnal 'byor bdag la snyan du brgyud/ bdag gis sbas dang gsang rgya thub par byas/ dad ldan grogs po'i rkyen gyis bskul ba'i tshe/ dkar chag yig ge ris su bris pa 'di/ rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro rnams la mthol lo bshags/ bka' skyongs srung ma rnams la bzod par gsol/ dge ba'i 'gro kun rig 'dzin sa thob shog/
